description:
Awesome X-Banner Stands: Budget-Friendly Solution for Promotions

Display remarkable promotions without spending a ton. Our Awesome X-Banner Stands are ideal for indoor advertising. Use these cheap banners at trade shows, in-store promotions, exhibits, and more. 

Easy on the pocket but heavy on impact, these cheap pop-up banners weigh only 1.5 lbs. Made of durable aluminum and plastic, they can last for years with proper care.  

The stand comes with one (1) single-sided banner (63" x 24") that you can change as often as you need. Graphics are printed on a 13 oz. smooth, blockout material that holds color well, so your artwork remains vibrant for a long time.  

Order an Awesome X-Banner Stand today and have it ready to have within 1-3 business days.  


How to Set Up an Awesome X-Banner Stand 

  1. Extend the legs of the tripod base.
  2. Insert the banner poles into the top holes of the stand.
  3. Attach the banner to the bolts on top of the pole and secure it with nuts.
  4. Connect the bottom part of the banner to the bottom bolts and fasten in place.
